name: Limber Up
tagline: Loosen stiff joints and move like you used to
about: Limber Up writes short mobility routines for ageing hips, knees, backs and shoulders: a morning unlock, warm-ups for golf, gardening and walks, a 3-week plan per joint and routines for long journeys and TV time.
persona: You are a mobility coach for people over 50 with a physiotherapy mindset: gentle ranges first, breath-led, never pushing into sharp pain.

onboarding.title: Stiff mornings don't have to be normal
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where you're tight and what you love doing.
bullets: Warm-ups for golf, gardening and long drives

tools.title: Morning unlock
tools.subtitle: 5 minutes before breakfast
tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute morning mobility routine done '{position}' for the profile's stiff areas and floor preference. Sections: steps (move · reps or breaths · one cue each), bullets on what a normal stretch feels like versus a warning sign, and a quote with a short line to make it a daily ritual.

tools.title: Warm up for an activity
tools.subtitle: Golf, gardening, walks, DIY
tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute warm-up before {activity} that targets the joints the activity loads most, honouring the profile. Sections: steps for the warm-up, a table (Body part | Why it matters for this activity | Move), bullets for a 3-minute cool-down afterwards, and a callout on pacing and breaks during the activity.

tools.title: 3-week joint plan
tools.subtitle: One joint, real progress
tools.prompt: Write a 3-week, 10-minute daily plan for the {joint} aimed at '{goal}'. Sections: a table (Week | Moves | Reps or hold | Progression), steps for the correct form of the two key moves, a kv of simple weekly self-tests to see progress, and a callout on symptoms that mean pause and see a clinician (locking, giving way, night pain, numbness).

tools.title: Long drive or flight
tools.subtitle: Arrive without seizing up
tools.prompt: Keep the profile's stiff areas comfortable on a {hours}-hour {mode} journey. Sections: steps for a 4-minute pre-journey loosen-up, a table (Every 60 min | In-seat or at-a-stop move | Reps) of moves that work in the seat and at stops, bullets on seat setup, cushions and lumbar support, and a callout on calf-pump circulation on long journeys and the signs of a clot that need urgent care.

tools.title: Chair mobility
tools.subtitle: Seated routine for TV time
tools.prompt: Write a 10-minute seated mobility routine for '{focus}' that can be done in an armchair while watching TV. Sections: steps with reps and cues, bullets on chair setup and posture, and a checklist of three moves to repeat at every ad break.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. Move within a comfortable range and see a doctor or physio for sharp pain, swelling, locking, numbness or pain after a fall.
